verdict.rationale: Azure is a cloud platform where AI insights over a user's data is a fair question, so the axis applies. The pack documents no AI-generated insights or suggestions from user data. The only AI mention is Azure Copilot generating Terraform configurations, which is code generation, not data insight. Cost Management offers user-built filters and multidimensional analysis, which is not AI-generated.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
